description: Prepare a first-party buyer review page for one exact published offer and checkout or negotiation intent. Reads published facts and checks standard checkout with a forced dry run. The buyer must review and explicitly submit on the hosted page; this tool never submits terms, creates checkout, holds inventory, or pays. Terms and pricing are reviewed again on the page.

deliveryPostalCode.description: Checkout only: buyer-provided delivery ZIP for local delivery validation. Never guessed or placed in the review URL.

intent.description: Buyer-requested action to review on the hosted page: checkout or negotiation.

offer.description: Exact published offer key returned by discovery, for example services-0.

quantity.description: Checkout only: buyer-selected product units. Omit for one unit; respect the published stock and per-order limit.

shippingAddress.description: Required for shipped products: the buyer-provided US address, shared with Nexez only with buyer permission for this validation. Shipping uses product.shipping rates. Never invent an address.

slug.description: Exact published listing slug returned by discovery, not a URL.

variant.description: Checkout only: exact buyer-selected variant id from product.variants. Required when variants are published.

name: nexez_prepare_commerce
title: Prepare buyer-reviewed commerce
